features.name: log_sites_normalized
features.description: Scale-normalized logarithmic transformation of the number of sites, mapping the domain to a [0, 1] range to improve distance metric stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents large site counts from dominating Euclidean distance calculations in KNN.

features.name: fp_score_ratio
features.description: Scale-normalized fingerprinting score relative to the theoretical maximum of 3.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, normalized similarity dimension for fingerprinting behavior.

features.name: cookie_prevalence_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total cookie prevalence to overall prevalence, clipped to [0, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative intensity of cookie usage independent of overall popularity, creating a scale-invariant feature for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: resource_script_ratio
features.description: Proportion of resources that are scripts, clipped to [0, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes resource composition, allowing KNN to group entities with similar architectural profiles regardless of total size.

features.name: api_diversity_score
features.description: Ratio of distinct APIs to total API calls, representing the diversity of API usage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded metric of API usage complexity, improving distance calculations between entities with vastly different call volumes.

features.name: log_max_cookie_ttl_days
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of the maximum cookie time-to-live in days.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses extreme outliers in cookie expiration times, ensuring stable distance metrics.

features.name: high_risk_api_density
features.description: Proportion of distinct APIs that belong to potentially sensitive categories (canvas, audio, navigator, screen).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a normalized density metric for sensitive API usage, grouping entities with similar behavioral risk profiles.

features.name: weighted_fp_per_api
features.description: Average weighted fingerprinting score per API call, clipped to a maximum of 100.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes fingerprinting intensity by activity volume, providing a stable feature for distance computation.

features.name: privacy_owner_cluster
features.description: Additive indicator of organizational transparency, combining ownership and privacy policy presence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a discrete cluster indicator, helping KNN segment the space into distinct transparency tiers.

features.name: prototype_dist_high_fp
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype representing maximum fingerprinting behavior (score=3, max_resource=3).
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms raw scores into a geometric distance from a behavioral extreme, directly aligning with KNN's spatial assumptions.

features.name: prototype_dist_heavy_usage
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype representing heavy network presence (log_sites=11.145, log_resources=9.936).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a unified spatial metric for network footprint, improving neighborhood resolution for high-volume entities.

features.name: semantic_tracker_profile_similarity
features.description: Semantic assessment of the entity's API usage profile and resource distribution compared to typical unsupervised tracking clusters, yielding a similarity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-linear relationships in API usage that deterministic formulas might miss, providing a rich similarity dimension for KNN.
